summary: Ranged poke champion who wins lane by harassing melee players and blinding their autos. He's fragile and has no hard CC; anyone who can reach him with spells (not autos) or tank his poke until level 5 makes his life hard.
threats: Q (Blinding Dart) blinds you, so your autos miss. It's his only real defensive tool; track its cooldown.
Toxic Shot (E) adds poison to every auto. Standing near the wave means taking free damage.
W (Move Quick) gives him burst speed to kite away or chase.
R (Noxious Trap) at level 5: mushrooms slow and poison. Brush and river get dangerous to walk through.

matchups.why: Pantheon's damage is mostly spells, so Blinding Dart barely matters. W (Shield Vault) is a point-and-click dash and stun that reaches Teemo from range, and Comet Spear out-pokes him early.
trading: Throw empowered Q (at 5 Mortal Will stacks) whenever he steps up to last-hit.
W onto him, then Q + autos during the stun. If he blinds you, keep casting Q instead of auto-ing.
Hold E (Aegis Assault) to block his auto poke when he tries to trade back.
After W, walk back. Don't chase him through Move Quick.
matchups.early: Levels 1–3 are yours. Take the push and look for W + Q all-ins once he's below ~60%.
matchups.spike: At 5 he can start placing mushrooms; walk around brush. Your R lets you roam if he's hiding under tower.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and crash; take plates while he can't stop you.
matchups.jungle: W stun is easy gank setup. Call your jungler when he pushes past the middle of the lane.
matchups.build: Electrocute or Conqueror. Lethality items; MR boots if his poke is still hurting.
matchups.remember: Spells reach him, autos don't. Stun, spear, repeat.

matchups.why: Cannon-form Jayce matches Teemo's range and has far longer poke through Acceleration Gate. Shock Blast isn't affected by blind, so Teemo loses every range trade.
trading: Gated Cannon Q whenever he walks up to farm. He can't answer from that range.
If he blinds you, swap to spells: Q and Hammer E still hit.
Hammer Q onto him only when his W is down so he can't Move Quick out.
Stay out of brush he's had time to shroom.
matchups.early: Win the poke war from level 1. Push him low and make him back.
matchups.spike: His shrooms at 5 slow you; buy sweeper-style vision or walk around brush. Your lane pressure shouldn't drop.
matchups.wave: Push and take plates. Freeze only if you need to back off.
matchups.jungle: Teemo is squishy with no CC. If he overextends, Hammer E knocks him toward your jungler.
matchups.build: Electrocute or Phase Rush. Lethality items.
matchups.remember: You out-range him. Make every trade a long-range one.

matchups.why: Teemo's damage is magic, so Malphite's armor does nothing, but Q (Seismic Shard) is a point-and-click poke that blind can't stop. You won't kill him alone, and he can't kill you.
trading: Q him each time it's off cooldown; spells can't miss to blind.
Don't walk into the wave to auto-farm while he's poking. Last-hit with Q if you must.
Once you're level 5, R + jungler is the kill threat. Track his Move Quick.
matchups.early: Farm with Q and accept some chip damage. Buy an early MR item if he's winning.
matchups.spike: R at 5 gives you a gank threat. His mushrooms make walking up harder.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm under tower.
matchups.jungle: Your R plus your jungler kills him. Call it when his W is down.
matchups.build: Aftershock. Early MR (Mercury's Treads or an MR item).
matchups.remember: Buy MR, Q poke, wait for R.

matchups.why: Darius needs to stand next to his opponent, and Teemo kites him with blind and Move Quick. A blinded Darius can't stack Hemorrhage with autos, and his only gap closer is E.
trading: Don't walk at him while Q (Blinding Dart) is up. Wait for him to use it on a wave or trade.
E pull him only when he's in range and W is on cooldown.
Use brush to hide your approach so he can't pre-emptively kite.
Once you land E, Q + W immediately. Don't auto into a blind.
matchups.early: Give up some creeps under tower. Your goal is reaching items and level 5 without dying to poke.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R gives kill threat if you land E. Watch for mushrooms in brush.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm under tower; don't walk into the wave.
matchups.jungle: Ask for ganks; he has no hard CC. Call when his W is down.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Ghost for chasing. MR boots early.

matchups.why: Garen can't fight back at range, and constant Teemo autos stop his passive regen. Blind cuts his empowered Q auto; his only chance is reaching Teemo with Q speed when blind is down.
trading: Wait for Blinding Dart to go on cooldown before you Q in.
Q also removes slows, so use it to walk through mushrooms.
Spin (E) through him if he's close; blind doesn't stop your spin.
Back off after each trade; staying in lets him poke you more.
matchups.early: Concede some creeps under tower. Buy MR early.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R executes him if he gets low. Mushrooms make chasing risky.
matchups.wave: Let him push; farm under tower.
matchups.jungle: Ask for ganks; your Q silence makes him easy to finish.
matchups.build: Conqueror or Phase Rush. Ghost for chasing. MR boots.
